answer: The taper maker draws his wicks through the wax pot, and the tapers must hang straight while they cool. Taper wax melter chandler bond governs the drawing: a bond wax melters lodge after melting room trials. The grove is the first taper, drawn at dawn; the pigment is the last, drawn before the pot cools, and the fable is the pot itself, crusted with wax. A cheat must draw 89 false tapers and cool 89 false pots.
